name: Common reagents (herbs, salts, blessed water, conductive dusts)

description.value:
The petty fuel every working burns - a session's worth of salt, herb, and blessed water. Insufficient components = the ritual cannot be sealed.

  • Item Tier: T5
  • Availability: 5
  • Cost: ¥200
  • Profile: Consumed in casting. The T5/T4 baseline consumable; a session's petty ritual fuel. | Grade/cost scales with Ritual Tier (Rituals appendix B2 authoritative). Tags: Ritual, Consumable
  • Tags: Ritual, Consumable

Item Tier sets price, Availability, and mod-slot count only — never raw power.
